stratagems.name: Command Re-roll
stratagems.description: Re-roll one Hit roll, Wound roll, Damage roll, saving throw, Advance roll, Charge roll, Desperate Escape test, or Hazard test.

stratagems.name: Counter-Offensive
stratagems.description: Interrupt the combat sequence immediately after an enemy unit has fought to fight with one eligible unit from your army.

stratagems.name: Rapid Ingress
stratagems.description: Your unit can arrive from Reserves as if it were the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, during your opponent's turn.

stratagems.name: Heroic Intervention
stratagems.description: Declare a counter-charge with one eligible unit after an enemy unit completes a charge move within 6" of that unit.

stratagems.name: Smokescreen
stratagems.description: Target unit gains the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Tank Shock
stratagems.description: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range after completing a Charge move; roll dice equal to your vehicle toughness and inflict mortal wounds on 5+.

stratagems.name: Go to Ground
stratagems.description: Target unit gains the Benefit of Cover and a 6+ invulnerable save until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Grenade
stratagems.description: Select one enemy unit within 8" and visible to this unit; roll six D6, each 4+ causes 1 mortal wound.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description: This model can be attached to the following units: FLAWLESS BLADES

abilities.name: Duellist’s Hubris
abilities.description: At the start of the Fight phase, if this model is not leading a unit, until the end of the phase, it has the Fights First ability.

abilities.name: A Challenge Worthy of Skill
abilities.description: Each time this model makes an attack that targets a **^^Character, Monster^^** or **^^Walker^^** unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and re-roll the Wound roll.

abilities.name: Daemonic Poisons
abilities.description: In your Shooting phase and the Fight phase, after this model has finished making its attacks, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is poisoned. At the start of each player's Command phase, roll one D6 for each poisoned enemy unit on the battlefield: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

abilities.name: Daemon Prince of Slaanesh
abilities.description: At the start of your opponent's Command phase, select one of the abilities in the Daemon Prince of Slaanesh section. Until the start of your opponent's next Command phase, this model has that ability.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-6 Wounds Remaining
abilities.description: While this model has 1-6 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Supreme Commander
abilities.description: If this model is in your army, it must be your **^^Warlord^^**.

abilities.name: Serpentine
abilities.description: Each time this model makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move over sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height.

abilities.name: Perfectionists
abilities.description: While this model is leading a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the **^^[LETHAL HITS]^^** ability.

abilities.name: Euphoric Strikes
abilities.description: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, this model can use this ability. If it does so, until the end of the phase, add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 1.

abilities.name: Lord of the Host
abilities.description: If this model is attached to an **^^Emperor's Children Battleline^^** unit during the Declare Battle Formations step, this model has the Infiltrators and Scouts 6" ability.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description: This model can be attached to the following units: INFRACTORS, TORMENTORS

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description: This model can be attached to the following units: CHAOS TERMINATORS, NOISE MARINES

abilities.name: Obsessive Annunciation
abilities.description: While this model is leading a unit, ranged weapons equipped by that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

abilities.name: Doom Siren
abilities.description: In your Shooting phase, after this model's unit has shot, select one enemy **^^Infantry^^** unit hit by one or more of those attacks and roll three D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If an enemy suffers one or more mortal wounds as a result of this ability, it must take a Battle-shock test.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description: This model can be attached to the following units: INFRACTORS, NOISE MARINES, TORMENTORS

abilities.name: Warped Interference (Psychic)
abilities.description: While this model is leading a unit, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, models in it have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

abilities.name: Wracking Agonies (Psychic)
abilities.description: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one INFANTRY unit hit by one or more of those attacks made with its Agonising Energies. Until the start of your next turn, that unit is wracked with agonies. While a unit is wracked with agonies, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from charge rolls made for it.

abilities.name: Lord of Excess
abilities.description: While this model is within 3" of one or more friendly **^^Slaanesh Infantry^^**, this model has the Lone Operative ability.

abilities.name: Excessive Vigour (Aura)
abilities.description: While a friendly **^^Slaanesh^^** unit is within 6" of this model, if that unit made a Charge move this turn, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by that unit by 1.

abilities.name: Ecstatic Death
abilities.description: If this model is destroyed by a melee attack, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 2+, do not remove it from play. This model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

datasheets.name: Daemon Prince of Slaanesh with Wings

models.name: Daemon Prince of Slaanesh with Wings

abilities.name: Daemonic Destruction
abilities.description: Each time this model ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of this model and roll one D6 for each of this model's remaining wounds: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

abilities.name: Stimulated by Pain
abilities.description: Each time an attack is allocated to this model, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

abilities.name: Objective Defiled
abilities.description: At the end of your Command phase, if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

abilities.name: Icon of Excess
abilities.description: At the end of your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, if the bearer's unit destroyed one or more enemy units this phase, the bearer's unit takes a Leadership test. If that test is passed, you gain 1CP.

abilities.name: Excessive Assault
abilities.description: Each time a model in this unit targets an enemy unit with a melee attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If that enemy unit is within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

abilities.name: Icon of Excess
abilities.description: At the end of your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, if the bearer's unit destroyed one or more enemy units this phase, the bearer's unit takes a Leadership test. If that test is passed, you gain 1CP.

abilities.name: Daemonic Patrons
abilities.description: Each time this unit is selected to fight, it can call upon daemonic patrons. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in this unit makes an attack. an unmodified Wound roll of 3+ scores a Critical Wound. At the end of the Fight phase, if this unit called upon daemonic patrons this phase and no enemy models were destroyed by attacks made by models in this unit this phase, one model in this unit is destroyed.

abilities.name: Eager Patrons
abilities.description: This unit has +2" **M**.

abilities.name: Beguiling Grotesquerie
abilities.description: Enemy units cannot target this unit with **snap shooting** attacks.

abilities.name: Lethal Obsession
abilities.description:
In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, you can use this ability. If you do, select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. Until the end of the turn, when this unit **declares a charge**: 
- This unit can re-roll that **charge roll**. 
- This unit must end that **charge move engaged** with that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Frenzied Ferocity
abilities.description: This unit's attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

abilities.name: Scuttling Horrors
abilities.description: In your opponent's Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8” of this unit, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, this unit can make a Normal move of up to 6”.

abilities.name: Assault Ramp
abilities.description: Each time a unit disembarks from this model after it has made a Normal move, that unit is still eligible to declare a charge this turn.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-5 wounds remaining
abilities.description: While this model has 1-5 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Terrifying Crescendo
abilities.description: In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, each time a Battle-shock or Leadership test is taken for that enemy unit, subtract 1 from that test.

abilities.name: Airborne Predator
abilities.description: Each time this model ends a Normal move, you can select one enemy unit that it moved over during that move and roll two D6, adding 1 to each result if that enemy unit can ^^FLY^^: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

abilities.name: Glutton for Punishment
abilities.description: Each time this model makes an attack, if it is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If this model is also Below Half-Strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

abilities.name: Assault Vehicle
abilities.description: Units can disembark from this **^^Vehicle**^^ after it has Advanced. Units that do so count as having made a Normal move that phase, and cannot declare a charge in the same turn, but can otherwise act normally.

abilities.name: No Prey Can Evade
abilities.description: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for this model.

abilities.name: Monarch of the Hunt
abilities.description: At the start of the first battle round, select one enemy unit to be this model's quarry. Each time this model makes a melee attack that targets its quarry, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll. Each time this model's quarry is destroyed, select one new enemy unit to be this model's quarry.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-7 wounds remaining
abilities.description: While this model has 1-7 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Daemon Lord of Slaanesh (Aura)
abilities.description: While a friendly ^^**Legions of Excess**^^ unit is within 6" of this model, improve the Armour Penetration of melee weapons in that unit by 1.

abilities.name: Mesmerising Form
abilities.description: Each time an attack targets this model, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Shining aegis
abilities.description: The bearer has a Save characteristic of 3+.

abilities.name: Horrifying Beauty
abilities.description: At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit in Engagement Range of one or more units from your army with this ability must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if that enemy unit is Below Half-strength.

abilities.name: Daemonic Icon
abilities.description: Models in the bearer's unit have a Leadership characteristic of 6+.

abilities.name: Instrument of Chaos
abilities.description: Add 1 to Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

abilities.name: Soporific Musk
abilities.description: Each time an enemy unit (excluding ^^**Monsters**^^ and **^^Vehicles**^^) within Engagement Range of one or more units from your army with this ability Falls Back, models in that unit must take Desperate Escape tests. When doing so, if that enemy unit is also Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those Desperate Escape tests.

abilities.name: Unholy Speed
abilities.description: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for this unit.

abilities.name: Daemonic Icon
abilities.description: Models in the bearer's unit have a Leadership characteristic of 6+.

abilities.name: Instrument of Chaos
abilities.description: Add 1 to Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.
